entities.name: Damir
entities.description: A guildless wizard on Ravnica called the Voidwielder, a renegade mage with a vendetta against humanity.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled plane where Damir lives.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose list of ten most wanted criminals once included Damir.

entities.name: Spatial Rift
entities.description: A rift Damir opened without a permit.

events.summary: Damir appears on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals as a renegade mage with a vendetta against humanity.
events.quote: At one point he was on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals

events.summary: Damir accuses the guilds of mass murder and vows to remake the natural laws.
events.quote: Damir accused the guilds of mass murder

events.summary: Damir banishes his enemies from existence and is put on the wanted list for opening a Spatial Rift without a permit.
events.quote: He banished his enemies from existence

relations.note: Azorius listed him as a wanted criminal.
relations.quote: At one point he was on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals
